- The carbonyl is part of an amide: `C(=O)NCC1CC1`. So it's N-cyclopropylpivalamide.
- Attached to the cyclopropyl ring is a phenyl group with a sulfonyl group: `c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)/C=C/C#N)cc1`. This is 4-(cyanovinyl)sulfonylphenyl.

So the molecule is N-(cyclopropylmethyl)-2-(4-(cyanovinylsulfonyl)phenyl)-2-methylpropanamide.
